data.answer: Production data is deleted by dropping the customer's tenant schema and the associated storage objects. Encrypted volumes are retired by deleting their encryption keys.
For a severity-1 (P1) incident, which means customer data exposed or full outage, the response time is to acknowledge within 15 minutes.
The founder is the only person who can place or release a legal hold.
When a breach involving customer data is confirmed, affected customers are notified within 72 hours.
Yes, the current sub-processor list is shared with customers on request.
Security awareness training must be completed within 7 days of joining. Access to production systems is not available until it is complete.
Recovery Point Objective (RPO) is 1 hour (at most one hour of data can be lost) and Recovery Time Objective (RTO) is 4 hours (service is restored within four hours of a declared disaster).
Shared secrets that the person had access to are rotated within 2 business days.
The provided knowledge chunks do not mention ISO 22301 business continuity certification (they only mention SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001).
